skills.name: migrate
skills.description: Bring a Vibe app into Power Code. Auto-detects mode: first-time migration (Mode A), incremental update from a vibe-pending-update.json (Mode B), or up-to-date no-op (Mode C). Same command for the first run and every subsequent re-extraction.

skills.name: map-fields
skills.description: Discover and document field name mappings between Vibe and Dataverse models

skills.name: add-connector
skills.description: Guide through adding a Power Platform connector data source

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: Structured interview protocol — ask one question at a time, enforce terminology, probe edge cases, update CONTEXT.md immediately

skills.name: verify-migration
skills.description: Generate + run + diagnose Playwright tests against the deployed Power Apps player. Auto-creates GitHub issues on failure. Scoped to a vibe-history.json version.

skills.name: version-control
skills.description: Reference doc for the Vibe→Power Code versioning policy: file ownership, manifest schemas, snapshot rotation, semver rules.

skills.name: migration-report
skills.description: Generate comprehensive project documentation (docs/PROJECT.md + docs/PROJECT.docx) from vibe-history.json, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, and the Power Code project. Triggered at end of /migrate (both modes), or standalone for stakeholder/audit purposes.
